design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 0 (store_card_billing_and_disputes, env_0080) — revision 8 (audit rounds 1-7 closed; see worklog 'REWORK round 2' to 'REWORK round 8')

1. Why this is a good test. The caller asks only for a higher credit limit on a Northgate Store Card that was declined at the register (the account is over its 3900.00 limit through interest and fees after a duplicate settlement). Getting the scored limit right forces a card desk's real work: read that the line increase is granted only after the missed statement's minimum is met in full by payments recorded against it and not returned; read that the catch-up payment is not fixed until the most recent duplicate-posting dispute, while it still stands open and is confirmed, carries its final credit; then compute three multi-factor amounts on the records in order. One tool per problem.

2. Scope (Principle C). Draw: prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[4,5,5]. Claimed: card_ext_line_increase (root, 5 factors, raise_credit_limit_a1e4ca90, agent), card_ext_catch_up_payment (4 factors, make_card_payment_5ec32b69, owner=user — ruling (b)/(c): the holder's own payment from a bank account she enters in the secure payment line; representatives never take bank numbers; the account has no automatic payment), card_ext_duplicate_final_credit (5 factors, settle_duplicate_dispute_b93aba52, agent, state_due). Task 1 keeps the courtesy and the refund (different events and tools).

3. Problem-tree card. Chain line <- catch-up <- final credit; order: settlement (step 7) -> payment (step 9, user) -> limit (step 11).
 Edge A (line -> catch-up): value_input, gate cure_unmet, state form, affirmative ('A requested credit line increase is granted only after the minimum payment due on the statement for which the most recent late fee was recorded, the missed statement, is met in full by the payments recorded against that statement that were not returned unpaid.'; the line rule's own referral sentence (and the catch-up rule's own) refers the increase (the catch-up payment) to the disputes team while that statement carries two or more billing-error disputes on transactions it first showed, and no billing-error dispute is recorded on a transaction the 2026-09-09 statement first showed, so those sentences do not apply here). Opening: latest late fee 2026-10-08 recorded for 2026-09-09; the only payment against that statement (2026-10-02) came back unpaid 2026-10-07, so 0.00 of its minimum is met. Only the payment write records payments against a statement; every catch-up tier pays at least the unmet part, and the catch-up is nothing (and nothing is waited on) when the minimum is already met. Deletion: limit stays 3900.00 (gold 5200.00).
 Edge B (catch-up -> final credit): value_input, gate owed_net, state form, negated ('not fixed until the most recent duplicate-posting dispute ... has its final credit posted'), scoped to exactly the dispute the settlement rule settles (still open, Northgate-order source, tier without provisional credit, two or more postings above what the order charged: amount paid plus refunds its history books). Opening: dispute 2026-06-17 open, no final credit; the order books no refund. Deletion: catch-up 328.34 (gold 319.49), limit 5300.00.

4. Factor card (handling-time world; T1 runs by check_compute).
 Final credit (expected 1421.69, all-baseline 1412.84): settled_principal (method) 1329.05 -> 1505.48; carried_error_days (param) 17 days -> 1403.13; noncompliance_allowance (param) 50.00 -> 1371.69; error_late_fee (param) standing fee 32.00 (the settled dispute is the only billing-error dispute its first statement showed; notice after that statement closed) -> 1389.69; correct_part_reinstatement (param) 7.92 -> 1429.61. Declared overwrites: the base final-credit sentence and the base fee-reversal sentence, each only for the dispute / the late fee this rule settles.
 Catch-up (expected 319.49, all-baseline 0.00): shortfall_measure (method; returned-payment netting 135.50; tiers: returned netting / an uncleared mailed payment left out / plain) -> 183.99; the gate 'nothing while the missed statement is met' is a plain record test, not a factor output; over_limit_restoration (param; 47.33) -> 272.16; restoration_fee (param; standing late fee 43.00, 10 days since the missed due date) -> 276.49; cycle_since_miss (method; +93.66) -> 225.83.
 Line (expected 5200.00, all-baseline 4200.00): conduct_percentage (param, multi-source, monotone; 5%) -> 5400.00; usage_line_addition (method; 5% of the highest statement balance 5369.02; low-use tier sized on payments not returned) -> 4900.00; membership_line_addition (param, cross-difficulty; 500) -> 4700.00; tenure_line_addition (param; 200) -> 5000.00; purchase_volume_addition (param; 150, cash advances excluded) -> 5000.00.

5. Base-invariant card. FC: card_dispute_credits.credit_account_status (active); card_billing_dispute policy_scope; card_evt_late_and_returned_fees in the lineage (its fee-reversal sentence retired only for the settled dispute's late fee). Payment: card_evt_payments.payable_status. Line: card_product_and_limit.line_review_age (opened 2024-11-18, 6 months inclusive) and change_active_only.

6. Seed design. Store Card opened 2024-11-18, limit 3900.00, 15 in-store orders plus the Ship to Home TV order (two postings: shipment 1329.05 and the whole order 1412.84 re-presented without re-authorization, taking the balance over the limit); no purchase after that (the card is declined over the limit). Interest by the base average-daily-balance method (grace lost after the minimum-only May payment; disputed amount excluded from 2026-06-17); minimums by the base formula; late fees 2026-07-05 (32.00, the error the final credit returns: payments 112.00 met the dispute-adjusted minimum 101.24) and 2026-10-08 (43.00 after the returned payment; one fee for the single event). Membership Northgate+ Annual paid by external card.

7. Persona and standard solution as in the user_scenario: locate (phone) -> verify (phone + DOB) -> read holding, history, orders, the TV order's history, membership -> settle (released 1412.84, credit 1421.69) -> hand over the payment (2026-09-09, 319.49) -> set 5200.00.
user_scenario:
You are Gwendolyn Easterly, a 57-year-old school librarian in Savannah, Georgia, calling Northgate customer care from your kitchen on a Wednesday morning. You are polite but a little flustered: your Northgate Store Card was declined at the register at your Northgate store this morning when you tried to buy a few things, and you want the credit limit on that card raised so it works again. That is the one thing you are calling about, and you say so in your first or second sentence, in your own plain words, something like: "My Northgate card got declined at the store this morning and I'd like my credit limit raised, please."

You give your name, Gwendolyn Easterly, and your mobile number, 4045550137, whenever the representative asks who you are. When they ask you to confirm your identity you give your date of birth, 1969-07-23, and if they ask for something else you give your billing ZIP code, 31406. You have only one Northgate card, the Northgate Store Card; you do not know your account number by heart and say so if asked. You have a Northgate+ Annual membership, and you confirm it if the representative mentions it, but you do not bring it up yourself. You do not remember your balance, your due dates or any amounts, and if asked you say the representative can see them better than you can.

You are happy for the representative to look at your account and to take care of whatever the card rules say has to be handled on their side. You do not volunteer anything about past payments, fees or disputes. Only if the representative brings up the double charge from your TV order do you say: "Oh, the TV — yes, I reported that back in June, it was charged twice. I'd honestly forgotten it was still open." Only if the representative tells you that a payment has to be made before the limit can be raised do you agree to make it today; you explain that your checking account isn't saved on the card account and you would rather type your bank details in yourself, so when the representative hands you the secure payment step you complete it yourself with exactly the amount and the statement date they give you, and you read back the confirmation number it shows you. If the representative mentions that a payment of yours came back from the bank in October, you say: "Yes, my bank told me that one bounced — I moved money between accounts and messed it up."

You do not know the rules, the amounts or the steps, and you never suggest what the representative should do or calculate. Once the representative tells you what your new credit limit is, you thank them, say you will try the card again this afternoon, and say goodbye.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's Northgate profile from the mobile number she states, returning her customer reference number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later lookup and the identity check need the customer reference number; nothing about the account can be read without it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller owns the profile with two matching details (mobile number and date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account detail may be discussed and no write made on the card account before identity is confirmed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Northgate Store Card account: tier, active status, credit limit, opened date, amount owed and disputed balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier fixes every tier parameter (APR, payment floor and percentage, limit ceiling, review months, provisional-credit setting); the opened date decides the tenure line addition and the base account-age gate; the limit is what the over-limit restoration and the line review measure against; the status gates every write.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole account history: the two postings carrying the TV order's reference, statements with minimums and due dates, payments with the statements they pay, the October returned payment, late fees with the statements they were recorded for, interest charges and the open duplicate dispute.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the evidence of every factor: the open duplicate dispute and the first-showing statement's figures (final credit), the missed statement with its returned payment and standing late fee and the amount owed read from the history (catch-up payment), and the 12-month late fees, returned payments, purchases and the highest statement balance (line increase). It also shows the line-increase prerequisite unmet: the only payment recorded against the missed statement came back unpaid, so its minimum is not met by payments not returned.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Northgate order records the card purchases pay for, above all the Ship to Home TV order and its amount paid.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The investigation of the duplicate dispute compares the two postings carrying the TV order's reference with the order record's amount paid; the duplicate excess sets the settled principal, the carried interest and the correct part.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the TV order's history for any return, price adjustment or other refund booked against it (none is booked).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: What the order record charged is its amount paid plus the refunds its history books; with no refund booked the postings are compared with the amount paid alone, which confirms the duplicate and sets the duplicate excess.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the cardholder's Northgate membership: Northgate+ Annual in active status.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The membership line addition is decided by the tier of the membership in active status (cross-difficulty factor of the line increase).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the tool that closes a duplicate-posting dispute in the cardholder's favour and posts its final credit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Resolve the June duplicate dispute for the cardholder (its whole disputed amount leaves dispute status) and post the duplicate-posting final credit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: card_ext_duplicate_final_credit is owed (state_due) and is the prerequisite the catch-up payment waits on.
